title: Blueprint.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe a Blueprint resource.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

appLicenseDeficient.description: Indicates whether the Blueprint has insufficient app licenses for all assigned members.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time that the Blueprint was created.

name.description: The display name of the Blueprint.

status.description: The current status of the Blueprint. See [BlueprintStatus](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/blueprintstatus) for possible values.

updatedDateTime.description: The date and time that the Blueprint was last updated.
